projects.title: Prognify
projects.description: An online programming learning platform with course enrollment, learning resources, progress tracking, user dashboards, authentication, search, filtering, and course management for instructors and administrators.

projects.title: NotePad - A Text Editor
projects.description: A desktop text editor built for writing and managing plain text files. Supports file creation, editing, saving, and formatting within a simple user interface.

projects.title: Autonomous Navigation Car
projects.description: Developed a robotic navigation system integrating microprocessors, multi-sensor telemetry, and motor control circuits. Highlights expertise in low-level firmware programming, signal processing, and autonomous obstacle avoidance.
